text:
Samir K.: quick sync — hitting a flaky case in node/python SDKs when stream is cancelled during auth token refresh + automatic retry. not sure if it's a retry/teardown race. cc @Jess M.

Jess M.: can you paste minimal repro? which SDK versions?

Samir K.: Node @ 0.9.2, Py @ 0.8.7. repro: start streaming generate, server returns 401 mid-stream, client calls token refresh, SDK retries request but AbortController was already signaled by app. result = unhandled exception + hanging stream in node. in py it closes fine but response is empty.

Olivia C.: hmm. do we do idempotency keys for streaming retries? I thought streaming isn't retryable by default.

Samir K.: It's supposed to be non-retryable, but our automatic token-refresh layer wraps the transport and tries transparently. code snippet:

```
// node
const ac = new AbortController();
const res = client.responses.stream({ prompt }, { signal: ac.signal });
setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), 2000);
```

Server 401 triggers refresh -> transport issues a retry -> AbortController had fired -> we end up in a half-closed state.

Jess M.: probable bug: transport retry code doesn't check signal before re-issuing request. Should check signal.aborted and throw. also need to cancel any in-flight retry timers.

Liam P.: will investigate. quick q: how do Python's contexts map? are we using threading.Event or asyncio.CancelledError?

Samir K.: Py uses async context + aiohttp.CancelledError. When cancelled we cancel the coroutine, but our token refresh task can still create a new request.

Olivia C.: Proposed fix: before retry, do if (signal && signal.aborted) -> bail; and ensure any background refresh awaits signal or observes cancellation. Also add telemetry to count retries triggered post-cancel.

Jess M.: agree. add unit that simulates race: abort at time T1, server 401 at T2 slightly after; assert no retry attempted.

Liam P.: I'll open PR for node to short-circuit retries (PR #1428). will also add js test in harness and a flaky repro harness.

Samir K.: awesome. for python I'll add test and change refresh wrapper to check cancellation token. I'll ping when PRs ready. thanks!

ci-bot: build queued for PR #1428 — tests running :gear:

Jess M.: follow-up: add release note about streaming non-retryable semantics + token-refresh caveat.

Samir K.: added to the changelog draft.
